newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Taiwan GDRs off on electronics fall.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Taiwan GDRs off on electronics fall.

text.p: Taiwanese global depositary receipts pulled back on Monday following a fall in electronics stocks in the local market, traders said.

They said the Taiwanese GDR market, dominated by electronics stocks, came under pressure in relatively thin trade following losses in Taipei. But they said sentiment on Taiwan's market overall remained positive.
The Taiwanese market has been volatile recently, and one London trader said the local weighted index could test 10,000 soon after threatening the level last week.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index shed 5.89 points, or 4.18 percent to 134.84, representing a discount to the local market of 3.15 percent.
Indian GDRs fell back in light trade and amid low interest. Dealers said the market was entering a summer lull, with few issues standing out on the day.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 1.25 points lower at 83.05, a 1.49 percent fall, with the premium over the local market at 18.11 percent from 20.54 percent.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index shed 1.31 points to 93.23 -- a 18.45 percent premium to the local market. It measures from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
Bombay's benchmark index added 29.47 points to 4,154.28.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index shed 1.03 points to 74.78 points, a premium of 41.32 percent over the local market from 43.17 percent.
